claims.text: After finishing Compare & Restore Fields wizard a restore session starts and an email is sent on success or failure
Restore session state can be checked in the Activity section
Restore session statistics can be viewed
Restore Sessions viewed on Activity page with properties per session
Restore Reason field; reason saved to session history
Restore reason section to specify a reason
Restore reason can be set, e.g. Test Field Restore
Email notification once the restore completes successfully or fails
Restore Reason field; reason saved to session history for later reference
Veeam Agent for Windows supports object storage as a backup location
Standalone full backups cannot be created when backups are stored in object storage
Defragment and compact full backup file option not available for object storage targets
Without periodic active fulls, a full backup is still needed to assign a GFS flag
Synthesized full does not retrieve actual data blocks from object storage to avoid costs
If the service cannot connect to object storage, a new restore point is immediately created in the backup cache
On lost connection during a job, agent reconnects up to 30+ minutes then writes remaining data to backup cache
With HTTP/HTTPS proxies, backup to object storage only through a gateway server
1 MB storage optimization is limited to SAN/DAS/local and does not apply to object storage

A.notes: Misses lifecycle rules, synthetic full, HTTPS and Azure V1 limits; [14] only recommends 1 MB for SAN/DAS/local and says nothing about object storage, and [4]'s 'immediately' is stated only for network shares.

No data recovery options with read-only credentials
With HTTP/HTTPS proxies, only through a gateway server
Multiple buckets: agent ignores workloads per bucket, single child bucket
SOBR with multiple object storage performance-tier repos in direct mode: only backup-server-managed jobs
Azure Blob soft delete not supported; Cool tier not supported for direct connection

Object storage backups cannot be used for bare metal recovery

No direct backup for Kasten Kubernetes persistent volume backups
